newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Soggy notionnel to slide if 128.78 breaks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Soggy notionnel to slide if 128.78 breaks.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF will remain negative on Wednesday and could head significantly lower if immediate support levels at 128.78, 74 fail, technical analysts said.
"The market is negative, it is holding on and trying to hold the price, but it looks like it will go lower," said Raynard Cheng, technical analyst at First Chicago in London.
"Support is at 128.78, which we tested this morning. The risk is still to the downside and on a significant break below there we would be looking down towards 128.33," he said.
At 0755 GMT, September notionnel was unchanged at 128.94.
